title: encrypt.rs: build_p256_recipient and build_p384_recipient are structural duplicates
description: build_p256_recipient and build_p384_recipient (encrypt.rs) share identical structure: extract public key, generate ephemeral, ECDH, ecdh_wrap_cek, build OriginatorPublicKey, build IAS, construct KARI RecipientInfo. They differ only in the curve type (NistP256/NistP384), KDF OID, wrap OID, and wrap key size. Both functions exist because each curve requires a distinct concrete type. Suggested rewrite: extract a generic helper 'fn build_ecdh_recipient<C: elliptic_curve::Curve + ...>(cert, cek, rng, kdf_oid, wrap_oid, wrap_bits) -> Result<RecipientInfo, SmimeError>' and have both callers instantiate it. This removes ~50 lines of duplication and makes it obvious the two code paths are identical in structure.
